events.verdict: Tatum (BOS) deflects the ball out of bounds.
Holiday (BOS) initiates more-than-marginal contact to Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm during his driving shot attempt.
Green (MIL) extends his arms into Holiday (BOS), moving him off of his spot and dislodging him from his screening position.
Holiday (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position defending Lillard (MIL) on the perimeter.
Holiday (BOS) jumps to contest and any contact with Lillard (MIL) during his pass is marginal.
Brown (BOS) lowers his arm normally after making the pass and makes incidental contact with Green's (MIL) head.
Holiday (MIL) throws the ball off of Prince (MIL), who is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds.
Tatum (BOS) places his off-arm against Green (MIL) and releases as he steps back.
Lopez (MIL) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) gathers the ball on his left foot and legally takes two steps to the basket.
Horford (BOS) has his forearm extended when Antetokounmpo (MIL) changes directions but the contact is marginal and does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
Horford (BOS) extends his arm into Antetokounmpo's (MIL) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
